items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996

ctx.x: We are here today on behalf of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive with drummer/ percussionist Bob Rosengarden, a friend of Hamilton, and you’ve made how many annual trips here?
Many, many, many, thanks to Milt Fillius.
It’s a pleasure to have you again, and last night’s concert was—
